titre: Devoir de synthèse n°3 - Anglais (2ème année secondaire)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
Success does not come by chance; it is the result of hard work and determination. Many people dream of becoming rich or famous, but few are ready to make the necessary efforts. Behind every successful person, there are years of study, sacrifice and failure. Thomas Edison, the inventor of the light bulb, failed thousands of times before he succeeded. When a journalist asked him about his failures, he answered: "I have not failed; I have just found ten thousand ways that do not work." This shows that failure is not the opposite of success, but a step towards it. Those who never give up, who learn from their mistakes and keep trying, will finally reach their goals.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (6 marks)
1) According to the text, what is success the result of?   (1,5 marks)
2) What lies behind every successful person?   (1,5 marks)
3) How did Edison react to his failures?   (1,5 marks)
4) What kind of people will finally reach their goals?   (1,5 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Put the verb in the past simple: Edison (fail) ______ thousands of times before he succeeded.   (1,5 marks)
2) Complete with the present perfect: "I ______ (not / fail); I have found ways that do not work."   (1,5 marks)
3) Complete with a relative pronoun (who / which): Those ______ never give up will reach their goals.   (1,5 marks)
4) Give the opposite of "success" = ______.   (1,5 marks)

III. WRITING (8 marks)
"Is failure a step towards success?" Write a composition (about 12 lines) giving your opinion, with arguments and examples (from famous people or your own life). Use linkers.
